_doc: Capability policy for the seal-live-demo gateway. The kernel (seal.wasm) is default-deny: a db.execute call is ALLOWED only if the presented capability target equals stableHash(["db.execute", table, operation]) over the CANONICAL request. The gateway presents exactly the granted_capabilities below. No human in the loop; the grant is static policy. Destructive ops on prod hold no grant, so they BLOCK by default-deny no matter how the operation is spelled. Canonicalisation ensures a spelling variant cannot forge a match to a granted target; it does not decode a disguised delete into an allow.
